title: Agent Hooks — approval seam
description: Approval request and resolution shapes for lifting a liftable deny (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §9). context_identity is an opaque provider-produced string, or null when identity_provider is null (§10.1); the only normative constraint is the echo rule.

LiftableDeny.description:
The liftable deny being consulted: an interceptor's (passes §5,
verdict.schema.json) or the host-synthesized §7.5 shape, whose reason is a
reserved host_error:* string that §5 forbids interceptors to emit — so this
member is validated against the §5 schema only when its reason is not
host_error:*.

request.description: What the host hands the resolver (§9).

context.description: The AgentContext as presented to the resolver. MAY be redacted per host policy.
context.title: Agent Hooks — agent context

context_identity.description:
MUST equal the request's context_identity byte for byte (echo rule, §9);
null echoes as null.

ApproveResolution.description: approve: the resolver lifts the deny with an allow or transform verdict.

RejectResolution.description: reject: the resolver keeps a deny.

UnresolvedResolution.description: unresolved: no decision; the deny stands and no verdict is carried.

AllowVerdict.description: allow: proceed. Absorbs warn through warnings[] (§5.1).

reason.description:
Interceptor-supplied machine identifier. The host_error: prefix is reserved
for host-synthesized failures (§11).

warnings.description:
Recorded concerns that do not affect control flow (§5.1). Permitted on any
decision; unioned across an emission's verdicts (§7.3). Reasons starting with
host_warning: are reserved for the host (§11.1).

evidence.description: Offline-verifiable evidence attached to a verdict (§14).

result_labels.description:
Interceptor-supplied labels the host MUST persist with the produced data and
resurface on later interception points (§5.4).

Warning.description: A recorded concern that does not affect control flow (§5.1).

reason.description:
Interceptor-supplied warning identifier. The host_error: prefix is reserved
for host-synthesized failures (§11) and host_warning: for host-synthesized
warnings (§11.1); an interceptor warning with either prefix fails §5
validation.

Evidence.description: Offline-verifiable evidence attached to a verdict (§14).

verification_pointers.description: Named URIs an auditor MAY consult. Hosts MUST NOT dereference automatically (§14).
